You finish the exchange with a sweeping bow, already slipping beyond their reach.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Make a melee attack, then end the exchange with a flourish. After the damage, move up to 3 squares without provoking along a legal route.

Weak
4 physical damage.
Standard
5 physical damage; the target is pushed 1 square away before you move.
Strong
7 physical damage; push it 2 before moving.
